evidence: Matches the 'Wallet' label and modifies wallet cursor and migration code in src/wallet/db.h and src/wallet/migrate.cpp.
rationale: Prevents migratewallet from falsely rejecting valid legacy wallets as corrupt due to leftover stream bytes during cursor iteration. Migration correctness for the legacy-to-descriptor path is an explicit high priority for the wallet category, and leaving legitimate wallets unable to migrate constitutes a serious reliability and correctness failure.
